*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: .bin/build_outputs.py
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+query = """
+SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT AS year,
+       SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed)::BIGINT AS pedestrian_deaths
+FROM read_parquet(?)
+WHERE crash_date >= ? AND crash_date < ?
+GROUP BY year
+ORDER BY year
+"""
+data = duckdb.connect().execute(
+    query,
+    [str(ROOT / "data/crashes.parquet"), "2013-01-01", "2026-01-01"],
+).fetchdf()
+expected_years = list(range(2013, 2026))
+if data["year"].tolist() != expected_years:
+    raise ValueError(f"Expected every requested year; got {data['year'].tolist()}")
+data["pedestrian_deaths"] = data["pedestrian_deaths"].astype("int64")
+
+plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 10, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+bars = ax.bar(data["year"].astype(str), data["pedestrian_deaths"], color="#3274A1", width=0.72)
+ax.bar_label(bars, padding=3, fontsize=9)
+ax.set(title="Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes, 2013–2025",
+       xlabel="Year", ylabel="Pedestrian deaths")
+ax.set_ylim(0, int(data["pedestrian_deaths"].max() * 1.16))
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+data.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+ax.plot(data["year"], data["pedestrian_deaths"], color="#3274A1", marker="o", linewidth=2)
+for year, deaths in zip(data["year"], data["pedestrian_deaths"]):
+    ax.annotate(str(deaths), (year, deaths), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0, 8),
+                ha="center", fontsize=8)
+ax.set(title="Annual pedestrian deaths in NYC motor vehicle crashes, 2013–2025",
+       xlabel="Year", ylabel="Pedestrian deaths")
+ax.set_xticks(data["year"])
+ax.set_ylim(0, int(data["pedestrian_deaths"].max() * 1.16))
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+data.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False)
+
+print(data.to_csv(index=False), end="")
*** End Patch
